# Preface {.unnumbered}

This document is a transcription of the WWII journals of Dr.Richard Pomeroy. It contains three typewritten volumes (364 pages), two from deployment 1943-1945 and one from a family trip to Europe in 1966.

The source scans are available as a download from Google Drive here:

- [**Download Richard Pomeroy WWII (1943-1945) and Travel Journals (1966)**](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LXxYWEZ1VdvQyyWVQiBhJ2fNneKuZ-n5?usp=sharing)

This book documents the transcription code pipeline and publishes the resulting documents. Downloads of the transcription (DOCX, searchable PDF, and per-page CSV) are linked in the [Assembly](08-assembly.qmd) chapter.
